thread:
Bea (Design): dropped a keyboard-first compact concept for the p95 + heatmap card. aim: make the p95 tappable to open a small keyboard-accessible panel (no hover required) with sampling presets, copy CSV, and a tiny sparkline. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/keyboard-first/latency-compact-kbd

Bea (Design): key trade: avoid adding more visible buttons in tight dashboards. instead the p95 metric itself becomes the entrypoint (focusable). does that feel discoverable?

Omar (Eng): interesting. impl-wise making p95 focusable is straightforward. just ensure the focus target is wide enough to hit on touch. keyboard panel should be treated as a popover with focus management. watch out for extra reflows when injecting sparkline SVGs into many cards.

Riley (PM): ops like the one-tap entrypoint. less visual clutter. wishlist: when user opens the panel, the default action should be sampling presets (1/1, 1/5, 1/10) and a prominent "Copy visible as CSV" button. copy should make it obvious what got copied (rows, timeframe).

June (A11y): the focus-on-metric pattern is fine if we provide clear affordance: add an offscreen hint "Press Enter for controls" on first render, or use an always-visible small chevron that is keyboard-focusable. aria: p95 element should have role=button and aria-expanded toggled. popover must move focus into itself and restore focus to the triggering metric on close.

Bea (Design): plan: add a subtle underlined dotted focus style and a tiny chevron that shows on focus-only (not hover). small tooltip text: "Press Enter to open actions (sampling, copy)". also showing a mini-sparkline inside the popover to give context.

Omar (Eng): implementation notes: popover anchored to the p95 label, not the entire card. use existing popover component with role=dialog and aria-modal=false. for sparkline reuse canvas rendering to avoid heavy SVGs for each card. copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv) + asset-bot toast. throttle copies 1 per 5s.

Riley (PM): microcopy: prefer "Adaptive sampling" over "Auto-sample" in all labels and aria messages. copy tooltip text: "Copy visible timeframe as CSV (up to 10,000 rows)". toast: "Copied N rows \u2014 visible window".

June (A11y): also request: heatmap legend must not rely on color alone. add pattern icons in the legend, and include a sr-only summary: "Legend: low, med, high latency". p95 tooltip should include aria-describedby linking to a hidden label with units and percentile (e.g., "p95: 198 ms").

Bea (Design): will mock the focus styles, chevron-with-keyboard-only affordance, and popover content. adding a small onboarding hint that appears once: "Tip: press Enter on p95 to open quick actions" (localStorage-gated) per Riley's ops ask.

Omar (Eng): telemetry: events `kbd_actions_opened`, `compact_copy_clicked` with sampling_rate tag, and `sampling_preset_selected`. keep keys low cardinality. will feature-flag the new behavior and roll out to 5% first.

Riley (PM): capture also whether users use the sparkline in the panel (event `sparkline_viewed`) so we can remove it if unused.

June (A11y): happy to review the aria text once you post. small note: ensure toast is aria-live polite and does not steal focus.

Bea (Design): thanks, will update figma with the panel states (closed/keyboard-focus/open) and add the a11y checklist. pinging when assets uploaded.

asset-bot: uploaded 3 assets to staging/latency/compact-kbd/ (build 2026-04-02T09:58Z)

Omar (Eng): i can take the first implementation sprint if design hands off assets this week.

Riley (PM): sounds good. end.
